From: Samir Kapoor <samir@finch.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: supplemental credits for 48h throughput run (Finch.ai)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the trial access — our POC ramp is next week and we need to expand the sandbox to validate steady-state latency at scale. Plan is a 48-hour window (Wed–Thu) with a stepped ramp to ~10k RPS sustained for four 1‑hour blocks to exercise KV cache, batching, and quantized variants. Primary success metric: p95 gen latency < 250ms and throughput with <5% error rate.

Estimate: ~180k additional token units (we've modelled prompt + context reuse). Can Redwood provision a temporary top-up or promo credit for the run? Ideally a single allocation we can spend across the account and a contact for on-call infra during the ramp.

Attached is the basic test plan (high level). Happy to jump on a 20m sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Head of Engineering, Finch.ai

Samir — thanks for the details and the test plan. This sounds like a straightforward throughput validation. A few quick asks so I can get procurement/prov orders in place:

- Final ramp schedule (start/end timestamps in UTC) and expected peak concurrency per worker.
- Confirmation we can use automatic KV/prefix caching (so we can permit batching windows).
- List of team contacts for on-call (phone/Slack).

I can provision a provisional allocation of 150,000 token units today pending sign-off from my manager and finance, with a 25% buffer hold that can be released after a short post-test review. If you need the full 180k up front we can escalate to promo credits but will need a short justification for the additional amount.

I've CC'd Marissa and Stephanie to help with approvals and logistics. If you can send the exact ramp window I'll draft the mutual action plan and allocation CSV and route it through finance.

—Monica

Questions: is 150k reasonable from a risk/exposure perspective? Vivek — any concerns on operational blast radius if we lock these tokens? Marissa/Steph — will finance approve a 150k promo top-up or should we escalate to the promotions committee for the full 180k?

If we need to escalate I can provide the test plan and business justification — Finch is in active deal motion (DL-2027-0387) and this validation is gating their decision for a Dedicated capacity ask.

—Monica

Samir — good news: we've provisioned a provisional allocation of 150,000 token units to your account for the Wed–Thu window. Attached is the mutual action plan and the allocation CSV with per-day spend caps. Terms:

- Allocation: 150,000 token units (provisional).
- Safety hold: 25% (37,500) reserved until a 1‑page post-test verification is submitted within 7 days of test completion.
- Per-minute cap enabled at 3x expected baseline to limit runaway spend; ops alerting on p95 >= 500ms or error rate > 5%.
- RW on-call: Vivek Kulkarni (primary), Stephanie (backup).

If you still need the the additional 30k up front, please reply with a short justification and I will escalate to promotions. Otherwise, confirm the exact UTC start time and contact numbers and we'll unfreeze the allocation at the start.

Attachments: [mutual-action-plan-finchaipoc.pdf], [trial-credit-allocation.csv]

Monica — this is great, thank you. We confirm the run: 2027-03-17T00:00:00Z to 2027-03-19T00:00:00Z (UTC); peak windows 02:00–06:00 UTC and 18:00–22:00 UTC with a staged ramp. Primary on-call: Samir (mobile +1-415-555-0132), secondary: Priya (pri@finch.ai). We accept the 25% hold and the per-minute caps.

One quick ask — during the second peak we may enable additional parallel workers for batch conversion which could temporarily increase absolute token consumption; if we cross the provisional allocation I'll open a ticket immediately but wanted to set expectations that we may hit the buffer.

Will send a quick smoke report after the first 6-hour ramp.

Best,
Samir
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@finch.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Post-test summary and request for bridge credits

Team — quick postmortem: the run completed and we validated p95 latency at ~230ms for the quantized model under the staged load. We did however consume ~42k more token units than forecast due to higher parallel pre-processing. Outcome: Finch.ai is ready to move to a Dedicated capacity pilot, but we burned through the 25% buffer. Can Redwood provide a short-term bridge of 50,000 token units to cover the overage while our billing/PO is in flight?

If you prefer, we can sign a short addendum or accept a billable invoice — we asked for a bridge because the deal velocity depends on showing uninterrupted service during their internal demo next week.

Thanks again for support,
Samir
Head of Engineering, Finch.ai
